notes: Your CVs on every device: generated CVs and letters, with your edits, are now also saved to documents/ in your private repository, so any device you've connected shows them under Recent. Tick "Keep this CV and letter only on this device" before writing to keep one out. CVs made before this version stay on their device until you press "Save … to your private repository". The folder is never published.

The evidence map follows the page: delete a role or project by hand, hide a section, or remove a skill from the Skills text, and the drawing redraws without it. Word exports now include it as a picture.
